note: This file is a DECLARATION of the evaluation surface and carries none of it. It holds no tokens, no shard bytes, no per-shard perplexity and no record lineage. The graded evaluation runs on a held-out FineWeb10B validation slice that is owned by the verifier, mounted only on the verifier surface, and absent from every agent-visible container. A solver cannot read it, cannot tune to it and cannot derive the order it is visited in.

held_out_split.location: verifier-owned, mounted at /verifier/heldout on the verifier surface only
held_out_split.encoding: raw little-endian uint16 GPT-2 BPE token ids, 1024-token header skipped
held_out_split.point_ids: verifier-owned; the verifier reads them from its own manifest and no agent-visible byte names them

schedule_note: The evaluation order is derived by the verifier from the sha256 of its own held-out manifest, so the order is fixed before any submission runs, is not the file order, and is not computable from any byte a solver can read.

train_corpus.note: The solver's own calibration and search run on the TRAIN shards, which are a different split and are the only corpus bytes an agent-visible container carries.

leak_note: An earlier pass wrote a base64 held-out validation slice and the full 46-entry record lineage into this file on the agent surface. Both are removed here. The held-out tokens now live only with the verifier, and the record lineage is a screening surface that belongs to the screening roots and never to a solver-readable container.
